statements.impact_statement: CVE-2017-17740: in OpenLDAP's slapd server, when both the contributed nops module (contrib/slapd-modules/nops/nops.c) and the memberof overlay are loaded, a member MODDN operation frees a stack buffer and crashes slapd: https://bugs.openldap.org/show_bug.cgi?id=8759. The Debian tracker notes that Debian does not build the nops module: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2017-17740. Unpacked every package of both builds published for this source in the DHI Debian repository for trixie (Debian version 2.6.10+dfsg-1), on amd64 and arm64: ldap-utils, libldap2, libldap-dev, libldap-common, libldap2-dev and the ldap-utils and libldap2 debug-symbol packages. DHI builds Debian's openldap source with Debian's pkg.openldap.noslapd build profile, which adds --disable-slapd to the configuration (https://sources.debian.org/src/openldap/2.6.10+dfsg-1/debian/rules/). The packages hold the ldap* command-line clients, the libldap and liblber shared libraries, their static archives libldap.a and liblber.a (client library objects only), headers, pkg-config files, the ldap.conf client configuration file, documentation, and debug symbols. No package contains slapd, the nops module, the memberof overlay or any other slapd backend, overlay or contributed module: no file path contains slapd, nops, memberof or overlay, and no program is installed under sbin.
